title: Product page does not show stock availability ("In stock") for in-stock products
steps: Open the first product in the list (Combination Pliers, $14.15)
Look for a stock availability indicator on the product page
expectedResult: The page shows the product name, price, description and stock availability ("In stock" for an available product), matching the list card.
actualResult: Name, price and description are shown and match the list card, but no stock availability text is shown. A visible-text check for 'in stock' or 'out of stock' found nothing. Only out-of-stock items are labelled (the list card shows 'Out of stock'); in-stock products show no availability text.
